name: Embedded captions on a talking-head clip
summary: Captions burned into an existing talking-head video: verbatim rail plus a peak word composited behind the subject.
tsvg_note: Core is captioning your own footage with subject matting and occlusion; TSVG cannot play the clip. The caption looks alone can be redone over a still.

name: Standard caption mode
summary: Default: clean verbatim lower-third rail plus one embed climax word behind the subject.
tsvg_note: Rail is native text; embed-behind-subject needs a still plus a pre-cut subject PNG layered on top instead of a matted clip.

name: Cinematic caption mode
summary: Pure embed: every caption composited into the scene behind the subject, depth-matched blur and light.
tsvg_note: Only over a still with a pre-cut subject layer; footage, sampled light direction and live matte are lost.

name: Theme caption mode
summary: Themed constitution: rail + apex + plate reactions (dim, punch, shake, grain) per theme DNA.
tsvg_note: Rail/apex/shake/dim are group transforms and overlays; grade and grain of real footage approximated over a still.

name: Product launch / promo video
summary: A product URL or brief becomes a narrated launch promo: captured brand, UI screenshots, feature beats, CTA.
tsvg_note: Screenshots as images, brand tokens, kinetic type, TTS and music are native; any captured product video clips become stills.

name: PAS launch arc
summary: Hook, pain, agitation, solution tease, product intro, proof/demo, CTA.
tsvg_note: Story arc over native scenes.

name: Future Pacing launch arc
summary: Imagine, name product, remove pain, mechanism, outcome, CTA.
tsvg_note: Story arc over native scenes.

name: Demo Loop launch arc
summary: Question, product intro, demo cycles, trust, CTA.
tsvg_note: Story arc over native scenes.

name: Before-After-Bridge launch arc

tsvg_note: Story arc over native scenes.

name: Feature-Benefit Cascade launch arc

tsvg_note: Story arc over native scenes.

name: crossfade transition
summary: Old scene fades out as the new fades in.
tsvg_note: Opacity tween; native. Registry shared with pr-to-video.

name: blur-crossfade transition
summary: Crossfade with a blur, calm default.
tsvg_note: Opacity + blur; native. Registry shared with pr-to-video.

name: push-slide transition
summary: New scene pushes the old out left/right/up/down.
tsvg_note: Group translate; native. Registry shared with pr-to-video.

name: zoom-through transition
summary: Old scales up past camera while the new arrives (scene seam).
tsvg_note: Scale + opacity + blur; native. Registry shared with pr-to-video.

name: squeeze transition
summary: Old compresses to a vertical line, new expands from it.
tsvg_note: Per-axis scale; native. Registry shared with pr-to-video.

name: Oversized cursor eye-carrier
summary: A huge macOS-style pointer walks the eye across UI scenes and clicks to ignite the next change.
tsvg_note: Vector arrow path with transform tweens and click ripples.

name: Cut-the-curve technique catalogue
summary: Doctrine: cut at peak velocity, match direction and speed on both sides; parameters for 5 seams + 2 in-scene moves.
tsvg_note: TSVG has eases and group transforms to express all of it; no built-in velocity-matched seam preset yet.

name: Zoom-Through
summary: Within-scene text swap pushing toward the viewer with Z blur.
tsvg_note: Group translate/scale, mirrored eases and blur; native.

name: Inverse Zoom-Through
summary: Payoff beat: something bigger lands, moving away from the viewer.
tsvg_note: Group translate/scale, mirrored eases and blur; native.

name: Cut the Curve
summary: Default scene boundary: cut at peak velocity with matched direction and speed.
tsvg_note: Group translate/scale, mirrored eases and blur; native.

name: Waterfall Cut
summary: Word-by-word handoff between big-text beats along X.
tsvg_note: Group translate/scale, mirrored eases and blur; native.

name: Rack-Focus Blur-Cut
summary: Visible DSLR-style focus pull swapping states on the same surface.
tsvg_note: Group translate/scale, mirrored eases and blur; native.

name: Waterfall Entry
summary: Staggered arrival cascade from below for title cards and openers.
tsvg_note: Group translate/scale, mirrored eases and blur; native.

name: Nudge Curve
summary: Slow-fast-slow three-phase group slide within a scene.
tsvg_note: Group translate/scale, mirrored eases and blur; native.

name: Seam craft render doctrine
summary: Render-correctness rules for scene seams: stage ground colour, wrapper opacity, no white flash.
tsvg_note: TSVG composites scenes in one player with a scene background; white-flash class of bug does not arise from separate wrappers.

name: Figma import
summary: Pull Figma assets, brand tokens, components and motion into a composition.
tsvg_note: No Figma importer in TSVG; exported SVG paths and PNGs can be used by hand.

name: FFmpeg processing
summary: Format conversion, resizing, compression, audio extraction.
tsvg_note: TSVG needs no encoding; only audio prep (m4a) uses ffmpeg-like tooling at build time.

name: Frontend design guidance
summary: Design-direction doctrine: distinctive palettes and typography, no templated defaults.
tsvg_note: Applies equally to authoring TSVG styles; no TSVG feature needed.

name: Remotion to HyperFrames port
summary: Translate Remotion React compositions to HyperFrames HTML + GSAP.
tsvg_note: No Remotion importer in TSVG; a port would be a manual rewrite to TSVG nodes.

name: 3D camera arc from a flat clip
summary: A flat clip gets a slow orbiting 3D camera move using per-frame AI depth and a clean background plate.
tsvg_note: Needs footage, AI depth per pixel and a perspective GPU camera; TSVG can only fake parallax from hand-cut still layers.
